title: Spell out that Synapse's ACME support doesn't support ACME v2
body:
Synapse fails on startup if given an ACME v2 endpoint (see https://letsencrypt.org/docs/acme-protocol-updates/):

```
2019-08-16 20:57:52,893 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - - Error during startup:
2019-08-16 20:57:52,894 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - - Traceback (most recent call last):
2019-08-16 20:57:52,895 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 654, in _runCallbacks
2019-08-16 20:57:52,896 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     current.result = callback(current.result, *args, **kw)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,896 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1475, in gotResult
2019-08-16 20:57:52,897 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     _inlineCallbacks(r, g, status)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,897 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1416, in _inlineCallbacks
2019-08-16 20:57:52,898 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     result = result.throwExceptionIntoGenerator(g)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,898 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/python/failure.py", line 512, in throwExceptionIntoGenerator
2019-08-16 20:57:52,899 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     return g.throw(self.type, self.value, self.tb)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,899 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - - --- <exception caught here> ---
2019-08-16 20:57:52,900 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/synapse/app/homeserver.py", line 429, in start
2019-08-16 20:57:52,900 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     yield acme.start_listening()
2019-08-16 20:57:52,901 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 1416, in _inlineCallbacks
2019-08-16 20:57:52,901 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     result = result.throwExceptionIntoGenerator(g)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,901 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/python/failure.py", line 512, in throwExceptionIntoGenerator
2019-08-16 20:57:52,902 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     return g.throw(self.type, self.value, self.tb)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,902 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/synapse/handlers/acme.py", line 74, in start_listening
2019-08-16 20:57:52,903 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     yield self._issuer._ensure_registered()
2019-08-16 20:57:52,903 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/twisted/internet/defer.py", line 654, in _runCallbacks
2019-08-16 20:57:52,903 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     current.result = callback(current.result, *args, **kw)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,904 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/txacme/service.py", line 254, in _register
2019-08-16 20:57:52,904 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     client.register(regr)
2019-08-16 20:57:52,905 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/txacme/client.py", line 157, in register
2019-08-16 20:57:52,905 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     new_reg, uri=self.directory[new_reg]))
2019-08-16 20:57:52,906 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -   File "/opt/venvs/matrix-synapse/lib/python3.6/site-packages/acme/messages.py", line 251, in __getitem__
2019-08-16 20:57:52,906 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - -     raise KeyError('Directory field not found')
2019-08-16 20:57:52,907 - twisted - 197 - ERROR - - builtins.KeyError: 'Directory field not found'
```

This lack of support should be spelled out both in the ACME doc and the config comments.
